about: The falsifier: a line of a place's own lock had no act to land by. Accept refused every line the ledger's authority did not cover, so bound's own lock was edited three times this week by a script that signed lines and appended them to bound/TARGET.bound outside any act — dep/topos and dep/verify at epoch 237, dep/topos-json at 243 — with no gate run over them, no ACTS, and no lock but the one the script took for itself.
